1.fixedElementDescription:
Good communication skills are the primary qualities associated with Water. Since you are an outgoing, active Yang sign, you may tend to be a good speaker and writer. Maybe you can persuade anyone to do anything! Water is often connected with creative artistic ability too, so whatever your talents are, you can probably find a unique way to express them.

Flexibility is another trait common to Water-sign people. You probably tend to be physically and mentally dexterous, able to make quick adjustments in life and get yourself out of difficult situations with ease. However, you also may secretly enjoy a challenge or a chance to negotiate. It’s possible you have a tad bit of conniver and manipulator in you, if only because you like seeing how much you can influence others. It’s not your fault you’re so charming!

As a Rat, you probably tend to be independent and prefer being the leader rather than a follower. Positive Water is not necessarily associated with leadership, but it does lend you some related skills. When it comes to work, you could be opportunistic and entrepreneurial. The way rivers with their streams and tributaries seem to touch just about everywhere, you probably have an extensive network of friends and acquaintances who help you get where you want to go. You may be emotionally connected to many of them because of your empathy and general ability to know how others are feeling.

And, Water is associated with emotions. As a Rat sign person, however, your behavior is probably more often governed by reason, Your tendency might be to hold your emotions inside, but eventually they rise to the surface. Do you have occasional temper tantrums? Probably.

Just as rivers sometimes travel great distances, and Water seems to trickle endlessly after a rain, you probably get around and are comfortable with traveling and moving often. In the legend that explains the order of the 12 signs, the Rat is one of the first animals to cover the distance to Buddha, thus earning the honor of being the first of the 12 signs.

Finally, Water usually indicates intuitive, even psychic abilities. You may or may not be an intellectual, but you are likely to enjoy learning about philosophy, religion, and other esoteric kinds of studies. If you choose, you could probably do well in school. A downside to all this is you're likely to spend a lot of time in your head. This could lead to stress or at least difficulty in relaxing, as you may continually find yourself thinking, if not worrying, about one thing or another.

2.fixedElementDescription:
The ability to communicate is one of the primary qualities associated with Water. However, since you’re a passive, Yin sign, you may tend to be introverted. But, it’s possible you can be a forceful and eloquent speaker when the situation calls for it. Water is often connected with creative artistic ability too, so your communications skills could also lead you to activities or hobbies in the performing arts.

Flexibility is another trait common to Water sign people, but this may seem to contradict your Ox reputation for stubbornness! In you, flexibility is likely to manifest itself, even to a fault, in the way you adapt yourself to your environment. You're likely, for example, to go with a natural tendency to shoulder others' burdens.

In spite of your charge-ahead approach, under Water's influence you’re probably not a confrontational person. Water, and you, favor a more indirect approach. You’re more likely to wear down your opponents with persistence, as Water erodes rock or earth. In general you’re probably more of the live and let live type rather than a mover and shaker.

Compared to mountains and forests, land-locked Water is usually unobtrusive, and so is the Ox. You most likely prefer to work in the background rather than the in the spotlight. You may also be the strong, silent type, only using your communication skills selectively. While you could do well when thrown into a leadership role, you generally prefer just being a loyal follower.

Rivers with their streams and tributaries seem to touch just about everywhere. Similarly, you probably have a large network of friends and acquaintances. And, you may be emotionally connected to many of them due to your empathy and emotional feelings.

Water is associated with emotions. As an Ox person, however, your emotionality is usually contained. In other words, you don't readily display your feelings but rather carry them inside. This is a major reason why you are typically incompatible with Sheep-sign people, who require frequent emotional support.

Just as rivers sometimes travel great distances, and Water seems to trickle endlessly after a rain, you probably get around and are comfortable with travel. In the legend that explains the order of the 12 signs, the Ox is one of the first animals to cover the distance to Buddha, thus earning the honor of being the second of the 12 signs.

Finally, Water goes with mental, even psychic abilities. As an Ox, however, you may be more of a doer than a thinker. Nevertheless, you probably have good foresight and decent reasoning abilities. If education is something you strive for, you can do well with your Ox perseverance.

3.fixedElementDescription:
Cooperativeness is one of the primary qualities associated with Wood. Like the various parts of a tree work in harmony for the good of the whole, you are likely to feel comfortable working within a group for the common good. Make no mistake, however, as a Tiger you prefer to be the leader! With your sense of teamwork you can be a popular and respected member. You're also probably the first one to offer a compromise when a situation needs it.

Furthermore, you don't need to fake this behavior; it's probably a part of your sociable nature. Along these same lines you're likely to be extroverted -- a person who actively seeks the company of and being in touch with others.

This idea of interconnectedness also comes out in your humanitarian nature. As a Wood element person you are likely, more than most people, to care about fellow human beings and all life in general and to display kindness and compassion. This, however, can also be displayed in the form of tough love; you are a Tiger, after all. Also, you're probably more generous with your time and possessions.

Ethical behavior is another characteristic of your Wood personality. In you this could be a part of your humanitarianism, but it also may include a genuine concern for values and doing the right thing in your daily life. Regardless, you are likely to live by your own standards, not anyone else’s rules.

It sounds contradictory, but Wood is related to both stability and flexibility. If the Wood in your chart is at a moderate level, you are likely to be a solid person with resilience. Solidity refers to inner strength and stability, and resilience to flexibility. If you lack Wood, you could be too conservative and have trouble dealing with change. If you have an excess, you could be so flexible as to have trouble making decisions or staying with commitments.

Unlike a Water-sign person who deals with change by acting like a chameleon, you draw on your creativity. In fact, envisioning and creating are Wood behaviors. In the extreme you could even be avant-garde in your work and, or, personal life. As a Tiger you will most likely gravitate to the performing arts or other type of public position.

Some of the negative traits you might have from Wood include a short attention span, flightiness, and frivolousness. These are generally the traits of artists who are so immersed in their work they lose touch with reality. Although you are not likely to exhibit any of these in the extreme, you may have a tendency to display them from time to time.

Just like the various parts of a tree work in harmony for the good of the whole, you are likely to feel comfortable working within a group for the common good. With your sense of teamwork you can be a popular and respected member. You're also probably the first one to offer a compromise when a situation needs it. In fact, the desire to be a peacemaker is a primary Rabbit trait.

Furthermore, you don't need to fake this behavior; it's probably a part of your generally sociable nature. Although a Wood-sign person is likely to be extroverted, that is more a superficiality with you. As a Rabbit you are probably sensitive, easily hurt, and slow to recover. This tends to make you hold back and not expose yourself right away. In general, you strongly want to belong and be accepted, but you don't crave spotlight.

Although you might have a tendency to be self centered, you probably have a significant humanitarian side, thanks to Wood. You’re likely, more than most people, to care about fellow human beings and all life in general and to display kindness and compassion. Also, you're probably more generous with your time and possessions.

5.fixedElementDescription:
Creativity is one of the primary qualities associated with Wood. As a Dragon-sign person you might be an idea machine that cranks out a steady stream of big ones. You're also likely to have your eye on the future, thinking about creative ways to improve yourself---if not the entire world! It wouldn't be surprising to discover you're a trend setter, perhaps even with a taste for the avant-garde.

Although you might be a bit self-centered, usually because you’re totally engrossed in your grandiose projects, you probably have a humanitarian side thanks to the influence of Wood. Even if your most daring schemes do not involve the betterment of all mankind, you are nevertheless likely to have a good heart and a generous nature.

Ethical behavior is another characteristic of the Wood-sign person. In you, this could be a part of your humanitarianism, but it also may involve a genuine concern for values and doing the right thing in your daily life.

Cooperativeness is another trait commonly shown by the Wood-sign person, but it must be said you are probably not a typical representative of that type! It's true you tend to be willing to go out of your way to help others. On the other hand, however, you might be self-reliant to the extent you have difficulty asking others for help. And, more often than not, there are conditions put on your cooperation. Generally, you want to be in charge, directing your own projects, and giving rather than taking advice. There is nothing wrong about this; it just reflects your ambition, passion and autonomous nature. And, when it doesn't involve one of your grand schemes, you are more than willing to make compromises to create smooth interpersonal relations.

The Wood-sign person is generally extroverted, and that most likely is the case with you. You probably tend to enjoy the spotlight, seek leadership roles, and network with a large number of people. Your sociability, however, may be superficial, as you are more likely to be more interested in your achievements than building personal relationships.

It sounds contradictory, but Wood is related to both stability and flexibility. If the Wood in your chart is at a moderate level, you are likely to be a solid person with resilience. Solidity refers to inner strength and stability, and resilience to flexibility. If you lack Wood overall, you could be a New Year's parade Dragon -- that is, someone long on show and short on substance. If you have too much, you could be so creative and flexible as to lose touch with reality.

Some of the negative traits you might have from Wood include a short attention span, flightiness, and frivolousness. You may have a tendency to display some or all of them occasionally.

7.fixedElementDescription:
Fire manifests most strongly in Horse sign people, as it is the only Yang sign with Fire as its fixed element. Look out! Dynamism coupled with decisiveness is one of the primary qualities associated with Fire. In the old westerns, the first thing a cowboy always does after riding into town is to tie up his horse. It's Fire that instills in you this desire to always be on the go. And, you are not afraid to go after what you want -- now!

Charisma and flamboyance are other traits common to Fire-sign people. They contribute to your leadership potential and ability to inspire other people, not to mention your popularity. You probably often seek and find yourself at the center of attention. This could be due in part to your desire to impress, which is likely to be a more flashy than conservative style.

Fire's passion enhances all these traits. In you, it’s most obvious in the zeal with which you engage in physical activity. You may even be the type that lives for the game. There is also a steamy, sensual side to you. You probably enjoy working up a sweat, either on the field or in the bedroom.

A downside of your dynamism and passion is a tendency to have a short attention span and a quick temper. In fact, an inability to complete what you start could be one of your major shortcomings. You're also likely to be rash, which can result in your occasional tendency to rush into a situation without having thought through the consequences of your actions.

As Fire spreads until it’s opposed, you are likely to have above average ambition. This is most likely to manifest as competitiveness, especially when it comes to athletics.

Fire can warm if it’s controlled or burn when it’s not. You don’t generally harbor grudges or seek revenge like the Snake when you feel you have been wronged, but you probably show little remorse in simply walking away from a commitment when things aren't going the way you want. Although you are likely to be sociable, you tend to be independent and will only continue your participation in group activities that are satisfying.

Fire also gives you a sense of adventure. This is more likely to take the form of just enjoying being out on the open road of off into the country as opposed to travel to exotic places. You may, however, enjoy engaging in risky, physical activities such as rock climbing or sky diving.

6.fixedElementDescription:
Dynamism coupled with decisiveness is one of the primary qualities associated with Fire. Since you are a Yin person, this may not be obvious on the outside. Your decision making style is likely to be calculating, but that does not diminish the fact you are not afraid to go after what you want. And, with your mental abilities, you probably don't take that long with your decisions. Finally, it’s notable that your dynamism tends to manifest itself more as mental rather than physical activity.

Charisma and flamboyance are other traits common to Fire-sign people. This is a significant factor in the almost magical charm you probably possess as a Snake person. This also contributes to your leadership potential and ability to inspire other people. Although you might tend to tone down your appearance, you can and do create a commanding package when you choose to make your mark.

Fire's passion and enthusiasm enhance all of these traits. There's usually an intensity in your efforts, especially when it comes to intellectual activity. This probably manifests itself in your desire to acquire in depth knowledge of subjects that interest you.

A downside of your dynamism and passion is a tendency to be impatient and to have a quick temper. This could also result in you occasionally rushing into a situation without having thought through the consequences of your actions.

As Fire spreads until it’s opposed, you are likely to have wild ambition. As a Snake-sign person this especially comes out as an insatiable appetite for learning new things and having new experiences. In fact, Fire gives you a sense of adventure in general. The Snake is a karmic sign, which means you are likely to experience more than your fair share of extreme highs and lows in your life. Fire provides you the ambition to advance your self ever higher and also the willingness to take risks, which could lead you to some of those lows as well as spectacular gains.

Your Fire is of the negative or Yin variety, which infuses in you the warmth of a fireplace rather than the white heat of a forest fire. This is reflected in your sensuality, which could be remarkable indeed!

Fire can warm if controlled, or burn when it’s not. It contributes to your dark side in that generally, more than people of other signs, you harbor grudges and seek revenge when you feel you have been wronged. Mess with Fire, and you could get burned.

8.fixedElementDescription:
The fixed element Fire shows itself least typically in gentle, somewhat timid, Yin Sheep people. Its influence, however, is still there, but in unexpected ways. Dynamism coupled with decisiveness is one of the primary qualities associated with Fire. In you, that probably shows up in emoting more than doing. In other words, you're always likely to be displaying your emotions. And, your aggressiveness will usually be in the form of passive-aggressive behavior. If Fire exerts an extreme influence, you could have a problem with lack of self control. On the positive side, you are probably enthusiastic and vivacious.

Charisma and flamboyance are other traits common to Fire-sign people. You may have an attractive but unassuming personality and to enjoy a fair amount of popularity. The lady Sheep will probably display a charming femininity, as the Sheep is associated with the feminine. And, being a Yin person, you are likely to be more stylish than flamboyant in your dress and appearance. You like colorful surroundings, but your tastes probably tend to run towards pastels rather than gaudy or flashy things.

With Fire there is likely to be a steamy, sensual side to you. Many people may not realize this about you due to your calm exterior, but look out!

A downside of your dynamism and passion is a tendency to have a short attention span and a quick temper. In fact, an inability to complete what you start could be one of your major shortcomings. You may be a bit rash, which can result in you occasionally rushing into a situation without having thought through the consequences. This is most likely to happen as the result of an emotional outburst.

As Fire spreads until it is opposed, you are likely to have above average ambition. This is most likely to manifest as a desire for a better lifestyle and finer things.

Fire can warm if it’s controlled or burn when it’s not. You don’t generally harbor grudges or seek revenge like the Snake when you feel you have been wronged, but you may have a tendency to tell everyone all about your woes, painting an unfavorable picture of other people.

Fire also gives you a sense of adventure. As a mild mannered Sheep, this means something different from what most people would think. Your excitement is likely to be about outings close to home, trying something new but not risky, and attending cultural or other social events.

10.fixedElementDescription:
Resoluteness and inflexibility are some of the primary qualities associated with Metal. As a Rooster, you're likely to determinedly work towards your goals. This can lead to you being a perfectionist, which can work for or against you. Taken together, these traits have the potential of making you overly critical of others while you reject their constructive criticism. Even when all signs point to a needed change, you tend to stay the course.

These qualities, however, also contribute to you being quite competitive. You tend to have strong determination to finish what you start and win at games or athletic contests. You also can be very ambitious and will probably work long and hard to advance your position in life.

Metal is cold, and you tend to be a tad insensitive when it comes to the feelings of others. If, for example, you're not careful, a propensity to nag and harp could be hurtful and cause difficulties in your interpersonal relations

Under the influence of Metal you are likely to have a strong sense of self. This contributes to your self confidence and self reliant nature. You probably have an almost unshakable faith in yourself! This is a significant factor in your pluckiness, which is a primary, Rooster characteristic. It also contributes to a desire to be noticed, dress to impress, and to be admired. And, as Metal glimmers with proper care, you will usually shine.

Although the Rooster person is usually sociable, you still have an independent streak and can be alone in a crowd. In general, this means you tend to carry your own weight and to not seek outside help with any difficulties. In other words, you suffer in silence..

As a Metal person, seriousness is likely to characterize your attitude and behavior. You may be accused of not having a sense of humor, especially by those who don’t catch on to your quick wit.

Resilience is another Metal characteristic you're likely to have a lot of. No matter how many times you are knocked down by life's struggles, you're going to find some way to pull yourself up and get going again. As a Metal-sign person you will probably break completely or not at all. You may, however, be prone to bouts of sadness or melancholy, but they typically won’t last for long.

9.fixedElementDescription:
Inflexibility and resoluteness are some of the primary qualities associated with Metal. With your Monkey charm, wit, sense of humor and skill at manipulating people this may not be obvious on the outside. Make no mistake; you can be stubborn to a fault at times. Even when all signs point to a needed change, you tend to stay the course. These qualities, however, contribute to you being competitive. You tend to have a strong determination to finish what you start and win at games or athletic contests. You also might be ambitious and won't tolerate someone who slows you down or holds you back from achieving your goals.

Metal is cold, and you probably tend to be a tad insensitive to the feelings of others. This can be hurtful in combination with your relatively sharp tongue and sarcasm. You are especially likely to be hard on people you consider (mentally) slow, especially if they are in your way.

Under the influence of Metal you are likely to have a strong sense of self. This contributes to your boldness and self reliant nature. On the other hand, as a Monkey sign person, you still could harbor some degree of self doubt -- not that it'd slow you down from playing your games.

The downside to Metal's strength is you might be slow to accept (needed) advice or help from others and could be somewhat of a loner, even when you are in the midst of a crowd and appear to be the life of the party. You may also tend to hold your emotions inside and hide your true feelings from other people.

As a Metal sign, seriousness is likely to characterize your attitude and behavior. Some people may accuse you of not having a sense of humor. They, however, are probably either not around when you're exercising your sarcastic wit or stirring things up with one of your innocent, Monkey games!

Resilience is another Metal characteristic you're likely to have a lot of. No matter how many times you are knocked down by life's struggles, you're probably going to find ways to pull yourself up and get going again. As a Metal-sign person you will probably break completely or not at all. You may, however, be prone to bouts of sadness or melancholy. Indeed, Monkeys are famous for making everyone else happy but having difficulty doing the same for themselves.

11.fixedElementDescription:
Resoluteness and inflexibility are some of the primary qualities associated with Metal. As a Dog-sign person you are likely to work hard towards your goals. This can be especially true when it comes to your single-minded devotion to protecting your loved ones and your consistent dedication to any group to which you belong. Your inflexibility is more probably manifested as a tendency to get into a rut and stay there rather than stubbornness.

These qualities, however, contribute to you being quite competitive. You usually have strong determination to finish what you start and win at games or athletic contests. A quiet assassin may define you better than the vocal, attention-getter type. You also tend to be ambitious and will probably work long and hard to advance your position in life.

Metal is cold and you probably tend to be a tad insensitive when it comes to the feelings of others. You prefer to demonstrate your love by your actions rather than gushy displays of emotion. There could also be times when you do what you think is best for others without asking for their thoughts or feelings. Your efforts could actually make matters worse.

Under the influence of Metal you are likely to have a strong sense of self. This contributes to your self confidence and self reliant nature. You probably have an almost unshakable faith in yourself! This is a significant factor in what could be your strong, silent type personality.

Although you tend to enjoy the cozy environment of family and friends, you have an independent streak and can be alone in a crowd. This means you tend to carry your own weight and to not seek outside help with any difficulties. In other words, you suffer in silence.

As a Metal-sign, seriousness is likely to characterize your attitude and behavior. You may be accused of not having a sense of humor.

Resilience is another Metal characteristic you're likely to have a lot of. No matter how many times you are knocked down by life's struggles, you're going to find some way to pull yourself up and get going again. As a Metal-sign person you will probably break completely or not at all. You may, however, be prone to bouts of sadness or melancholy, but they usually won’t last for long.

12.fixedElementDescription:
Flexibility is one of the primary qualities associated with Water, and perhaps no sign demonstrates this as clearly as you, the Pig. You're probably a go-with-the-flow type of person -- someone who doesn't easily let life's struggles get to you.

The ability to communicate is another trait common to Water sign people. As a Yin sign, this may manifest in you more as writing rather than speaking skills. There will be times, however, when you can be as eloquent as you want. This is especially true in communicating with family members and friends.

Under Water's influence you are probably not a confrontational person. Water, and you, favor the indirect approach. You are more likely to wear down your opponents with your persistence, as Water erodes rock. In general you are of the live and let live type personality.

Compared to mountains and forests, land-locked Water is usually unobtrusive and so is the Pig. You most likely prefer to work in the background rather than the in the spotlight. You may also be the strong, silent type, only selectively using your communications skills. While you could do well when thrown into a leadership role, you generally prefer just being a loyal follower.

Like rivers with their streams and tributaries seem to touch just about everywhere, you probably have an extensive network of friends and acquaintances. And, you may be emotionally connected to many of them due to your empathy and emotional nature. In these ways, Water heightens your humanitarian instincts.

Water is very closely associated with emotions. Here, Water has a significant impact on you, as the Pig is one of the more emotional signs. This contributes to your genuineness, but it also lends itself to problems with self control. How well you manage this will probably determine the quality of your relationships.

Just as rivers sometimes travel great distances and Water seems to trickle endlessly after a rain, you probably get around and are comfortable with travel. The Pig, however, is basically a home and hearth person, so you always look forward to returning. You probably wouldn't be that comfortable with a job involving a lot of travel or moving too often.

Finally, it must be said Water goes with mental, even psychic abilities. You may be inclined to scholarly, spiritual, or philosophical pursuits. Since the Pig is more of an emotional sign, however, you may lean toward more humanitarian or psychological studies.
